correctness.rationale: The new proof establishes exact area formulas from tangent-line intersections and polar normal polygons; center choice is justified by n-fold rotational symmetry. The difference of partial derivatives factors into (cos(g_j)-cos(g_i))(B/D-A), and the displayed DA-B identity is strictly positive by an explicit two-case bound for total angle at most 2pi/3. Finite Robin Hood transfers yield strict Schur concavity on the closed simplex. Endpoint equality and the fixed-parameter quadratic expansion follow by direct substitution/Taylor expansion. An independent-coordinate Python verifier completed 12,100 deterministic comparisons; finite tests corroborate but do not prove infinite assertions.

value.rationale: The result classifies the entire normal-gap majorization order within an intrinsic, multi-parameter family of n-fold symmetric tangential polygons. Tangent-area and polar-area factors have opposing Schur behavior, making their strict product ordering substantive, not a routine combination of known polygon extrema. Exact equality, gap-order invisibility and positive local quadratic stability provide motivated structural information beyond existing endpoint inequalities.
